fields.name: Access
fields.description: Free, Free preview (part of it is behind a paywall or needs a subscription), or Paid. Shown on the website's Resources page.

fields.name: Needs Manual Check
fields.description: Text was auto-extracted from the test PDF; a check flagged a possible layout glitch. Compare with the test and uncheck when verified.

tables.name: Historical Events
tables.description: Major historical events in the United States, Britain and the wider world, as background for the literary periods. Years before the Common Era are negative (e.g. -490 for 490 BCE).

fields.name: Approximate
fields.description: Checked when the dates are traditional or approximate (shown as c.).

fields.name: Historical Periods
fields.description: The literary periods (and sub-periods) the event's start year falls in, for its region.

fields.name: Involves America
fields.description: For World events: checked ones also appear on the American timeline on the website's Periods page. Unchecked World events appear on the British timeline only.
